newsitem.title: USA: VISX settles patent litigation with LaserSight.
newsitem.headline: VISX settles patent litigation with LaserSight.

text.p: VISX Inc said Wednesday it settled a patent lawsuit it initiated against LaserSight Inc in Canada.
It said it would drop the lawsuit and has granted the St. Louis, Mo.,-based company a license to use certain VISX patents for laser vision correction outside the United States.
LaserSight would pay royalties to VISX on the previous as well as future sale of laser vision correction systems worldwide, excluding the U.S., VISX said.
A spokesman for VISX declined to disclose the amount of the royalty payments.
VISX, which has the most extensive patent holdings in the laser vision correction field, licenses equipment manufacturers to commercially sell their prodcuts in all markets outside the U.S.
LaserSight makes and sells lasers for vision care, provides managed vision care administration and manages ophthalmic practices and offers health and vision care consulting services.
